name: firm-buying-committee-map
description: Maps the roles in a client's buying decision (signs, funds, uses, can block, wrote the brief, runs it after), with what each role has said it needs and its source, stated or assumed, met or not met, and one question through your contact for each unmet role. Use for "run firm-buying-committee-map", "who decides on this engagement", "map the buying roles", "I have only met one person", "the signer never saw my pitch", "who else has to agree", "which roles have I not met", part of the Claude for Consultants · Team in Claude Pack by 90n.
